_comment: Knight Armor texts. File name = game language (Locale.currentLangName, e.g. EN.json, zh-CN.json). Missing file or key: English built into the mod is used.

knight_helmet.name: Knight's Armet
knight_helmet.description: A closed steel helmet with a visor, forged in the old way. Covers the whole head. Blades and teeth will hardly get through, but a blunt blow or a bullet still hurts. Heavy and stuffy.

knight_cuirass.name: Knight's Cuirass
knight_cuirass.description: A steel breastplate and backplate with a skirt of lames over the belly. Covers the chest and the abdomen. Stops blades and teeth, softens blows. Very heavy.

knight_pauldrons.name: Knight's Pauldrons
knight_pauldrons.description: A pair of steel shoulder and upper arm plates (rerebraces). Covers both upper arms.

knight_vambraces.name: Knight's Vambraces
knight_vambraces.description: A pair of steel forearm guards. Covers both forearms.

knight_gauntlets.name: Knight's Gauntlets
knight_gauntlets.description: Articulated steel gloves. Covers both hands. Clumsy, but a bite will not get through.

knight_cuisses.name: Knight's Cuisses
knight_cuisses.description: A pair of steel thigh plates. Covers both thighs.

knight_greaves.name: Knight's Greaves
knight_greaves.description: A pair of steel shin guards with knee cops. Covers both shins.

knight_sabatons.name: Knight's Sabatons
knight_sabatons.description: Steel armored shoes made of overlapping lames. Covers both feet. Loud on stone.

knight_gambeson.name: Gambeson
knight_gambeson.description: A thick quilted padded jacket worn under plate armor. Covers the chest, the abdomen and the upper arms. Softens blows and keeps you warm. Fits under a cuirass.

knight_longsword.name: Knight's Longsword
knight_longsword.description: A long double-edged steel sword with a cross guard. Hits harder and reaches further than a machete, but is slower and heavier. Plate armor turns its edge.

knight_ti_helmet.name: Titanium Armet
knight_ti_helmet.description: A closed armet forged from titanium sheets. Covers the whole head. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_cuirass.name: Titanium Cuirass
knight_ti_cuirass.description: A titanium breastplate and backplate with a skirt of lames. Covers the chest and the abdomen. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_pauldrons.name: Titanium Pauldrons
knight_ti_pauldrons.description: A pair of titanium shoulder and upper arm plates. Covers both upper arms. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_vambraces.name: Titanium Vambraces
knight_ti_vambraces.description: A pair of titanium forearm guards. Covers both forearms. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_gauntlets.name: Titanium Gauntlets
knight_ti_gauntlets.description: Articulated titanium gloves. Covers both hands. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_cuisses.name: Titanium Cuisses
knight_ti_cuisses.description: A pair of titanium thigh plates. Covers both thighs. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_greaves.name: Titanium Greaves
knight_ti_greaves.description: A pair of titanium shin guards with knee cops. Covers both shins. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_sabatons.name: Titanium Sabatons
knight_ti_sabatons.description: Titanium armored shoes made of overlapping lames. Covers both feet. Titanium layers are light and almost no edge or tooth can cut through them.

knight_ti_longsword.name: Titanium Longsword
knight_ti_longsword.description: A long titanium sword with a cross guard. Light for its size, keeps its edge for ages and cuts deeper than any machete. Only titanium plate can stop it.
